svg.title: These are curvature loop value and first-jet normalizations, distinct from the potential jet normal- ization. They are carried in the issued path data as the summable loop terms and their zero sums; joining path families preserves them by absolute summation. The path-data construction retains these identities along with the quadratic metric normalization, so (TF18) applies to the family actually used in (LCE6). Let L be the retained finite set. Subtracting its sum from (TF18) gives X γ∈L ca,b γ = − X γ /∈L ca,b γ , X γ∈L ca,b γ (zγ)l = − X γ /∈L ca,b γ (zγ)l. (TF19)
